title: Floorshow, Don Byas and the honking tenor battle
summary: Tenor Floorshow won sessions with flip-flops and honking until Don Byas jumped on the floor too and chased him to the bar during Cherokee.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: who you -- they called him Floorshow, at this session.
Floorshow, you'd be playing and all of a sudden, Floorshow would jump out and do a flip-flop with this horn and start a honking and break the house up and then, he has won the battle.

So, Don (inaudible Byas) had watched Floorshow for a few times when he'd been doing that so, this was another of them sessions, tenor saxophone sessions, so, they was playing 'Cherokee' and everybody was happy, you know, all of a sudden, Floorshow jumps out and does his flip-flop -- (verbally demonstrating).

Don jumped out there with him, you'll never do that to me, you'll never go into that, we gone lay right here and I'm going to run you out of here, and Don got on that floor with him, with Floorshow, you see, Floorshow made a mistake.
He'd jump out there and he would honk and honk and honk and then you couldn't play nothing else. Don honked with him and then started to running, he's chasing Floorshow.
Floorshow went to the bar, gimme a double, gimme a bottle. Metcalf says, well, I can't -- he says, keep pouring them then. And forgot to get up on the stand again.
That's Don Byas's phonetic theme too -- see, Don was a vindictive demon. Now, the last time I saw Don was in New York.
